'''Raider Arms''' was a company founded by [[Joran Raider]], after he left [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]]. It manufactured the [[Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol/Legends|Model-1 "Nova Viper" blaster pistol]], a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Fly">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>
